Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when a character is provided as an initialization argument to StringBuffer/StringBuilder constructor. The character is converted into its integer value, which is used to size the internal buffer. In this case, 'c' is converted to 99, which leads to an internal buffer that is 99 characters long, misleading the programmer to believe that the buffer is just 1 character long.
